_about.how: copy this file to configs/paths.json; relative paths are relative to the repository root, absolute paths work too; environment variables PRC_<KEY> override an entry
_about.organiser: the challenge files: training_2025-01-01_2025-02-01.parquet ... training_2025-12-01_2026-01-01.parquet (12 months), ranking.parquet, submitting.parquet
_about.adsb_clocks: one clock_<YYYY-MM-DD>.parquet per day: ADS-B stand clock, pushback signature, first ground point per departure (scripts/build_adsb_clocks.py builds them from the adsb.lol trace archive, ODbL; the raw traces it keeps under raw/<day>/ feed taxiout.build_extra)
_about.metar: one parquet per station: hourly METAR (scripts/download_metar.py writes here)
_about.open_meteo: open_meteo_hourly.parquet: Open-Meteo historical forecast per airport-hour (scripts/download_open_meteo.py --root <folder> writes it)
_about.eurocontrol: EUROCONTROL airport statistics: daily traffic and taxi tables and the monthly taxi-out statistics (parquet files)
_about.atfm: airport_arrival_atfm_delay.parquet: EUROCONTROL daily airport arrival ATFM delay
_about.opdi: OPDI (EUROCONTROL open data): flight_list/ and flight_events/ folders of monthly parquet files
_about.extra: the ADS-B-derived inputs built by python -m taxiout.build_extra: taxi_<day>.parquet, stops/, stops2/, opdi_events.parquet, opdi_types.parquet, inbound.parquet, hotspots.parquet, hotspots2.parquet
_about.reference: optional: an earlier model's holdout predictions (MVT_ID_mvt + one prediction column), used only to report a comparison; null to skip
_about.ranking_template_jan_jul: optional, final phase only: the January/July 2026 submitting.parquet (344,841 rows) of the first ranking set; src/v77/final_postprocess.py writes a January/July file in its order while PRC_ORGANISER points at the final organiser folder (null: that file is skipped)
